content.comment_body: Hello, I followed your logic for the counter program. When I set the timer value on the [product_name] display, it shows and works correctly. However, after I power off the panel, all timer settings are lost and reset automatically. I need the settings to remain unchanged after powering the [product_name] off and on.
Please share your program for review.

You should activate the 'Retentivity' option in the counter parameters to ensure values are maintained after power cycles. Open all related counter settings and check for this option. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user experiences loss of timer settings configured via the display on a [product_name] every time the panel is powered down and restarted. This affects operational continuity, as the user expects programmable settings to persist. Replies reveal a lack of awareness about retentivity settings, showing users struggle to maintain configuration without clear instruction. The product’s default behavior does not align with what users consider standard for persistent parameter storage.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate timer settings entered directly on the display to remain intact after cycling power on the [product_name]. They want configuration parameters to persist without needing to perform extra or hidden steps.
